name: asr_benchmark_malay_normalized_llm.json
description: This benchmark evaluates automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance for Malay audio, using normalized transcripts intended for downstream LLM consumption and standardized evaluation. It measures how well ASR systems transcribe Malay across speakers and recording conditions, enabling comparison of models and normalization/post-processing approaches. Primary focus is transcription accuracy under realistic Malay speech scenarios.
reputation: A niche, language-specific benchmark with growing use in Malay ASR research but limited adoption relative to major multilingual ASR benchmarks.
